key_point: Nintendo's secret weapon was a toy robot
title: Nintendo's secret weapon was a toy robot
caption: R.O.B. the robot was a trick to sneak the NES into American stores. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #nes #nintendo

instagram.caption:
When Nintendo launched the NES in America, stores did not want video games after the 1983 crash.

So Nintendo shipped it with R.O.B., the Robotic Operating Buddy, and marketed the whole thing as a toy. It even looked like a VCR, not a game console.

Only two games ever supported R.O.B., but it got the NES on shelves, and the console revived the whole industry.

Did you ever own R.O.B.?
